subject.title: fix(qa): repair smoke scenario lane selection

question: Should this PR be narrowed to scenario metadata only, or should it wait for and/or merge the channel-compatible QA Smoke replacement before re-enabling the required check?
rationale: The branch intentionally re-enables a workflow path that the current planner and PR body both indicate is still not merge-safe; choosing whether this is evidence-only or part of the landing path is a maintainer workflow decision.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Remove the monolithic QA Smoke CI re-enable from this PR and keep only the scenario metadata/test repairs, then restore CI through the sharded replacement.

options.title: Adopt the replacement path
options.body: Resolve the broader replacement at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101186 and land the channel-compatible workflow with proof instead of merging this monolithic job.

options.title: Keep evidence-only
options.body: Leave this PR open or close it manually after the replacement lands if its only purpose is to expose the remaining workflow-level failure.

recommendation.title: Narrow before merge
recommendation.body: Remove the monolithic QA Smoke CI re-enable from this PR and keep only the scenario metadata/test repairs, then restore CI through the sharded replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the broader replacement PR that appears to be the intended channel-compatible landing path.
